presets.name: Competitive FPS
presets.description: Lifts shadows and boosts colour so players stand out in dark corners. A good start for CS2, Valorant and Apex.

presets.name: CS2 Vibrant
presets.description: Strong vibrance with slightly brighter midtones, close to what many pros run.

presets.name: Valorant Clear
presets.description: Crisper contrast and a little extra saturation for ability effects and enemy outlines.

presets.name: Battle Royale Long Range
presets.description: Brighter distant shadows without washing out the sky.

presets.name: Cinematic
presets.description: Deeper blacks and a touch more contrast for films and story games.

presets.name: Evening
presets.description: Warmer, gentler light for the evening. Easy on the eyes after sunset.

presets.name: Night Reading
presets.description: Warm and dim for reading late at night.

presets.name: Dark Room
presets.description: Lowers overall brightness below what your monitor's own setting allows.

presets.name: Daylight Office
presets.description: Slightly warm and neutral for long workdays.

presets.name: Retro Arcade
presets.description: Saturated, punchy colour with a little warmth, like an old CRT.
